# Known-synthetic live-shaped credentials, excluded from the secret scanner.
#
# Every entry must be a value that was NEVER issued by Razorpay and therefore
# cannot be used against anyone. They exist because the strongest tests we have
# are the ones asserting that a live key is REJECTED — and that assertion is
# impossible to write without a live-shaped string.
#
# Adding a line here is a claim that the value is worthless. Do not add a real
# key. If a real key reaches this file, rotate it instead.
#
# Prefer the inline `pragma: allow-live-key` comment for new fixtures; this
# file exists because git history is immutable and the two entries below were
# committed before that pragma existed.

# src/config.test.ts — asserts parseConfig() refuses to boot on a live key.
rzp_live_1234567890abcd

# src/telemetry/redact.test.ts — asserts the log redactor scrubs live keys.
rzp_live_AbCdEf123456
